Name: Special Qi Seasoning
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[u][b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b][/u]

This is a very simple Content Patcher content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55633]Custom Seasonings[/url] that adds a new item to the game, Special Qi Seasoning, which turns ordinary dishes into iridium quality dishes, doubling their buff duration, and adding two levels to each buffed attribute of any given dish.

Dishes without existing buffs will not benefit from this seasoning.

Special Qi Seasoning should be available in the Qi Gem Shop for 20 gems.


[u][b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b][/u]

Requires Content Patcher and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55633]Custom Seasonings[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
